title: The Settings forms draw the shared switch, not a hand-built one the Frequency bridge had to repaint

source.ref: LIVE-938 area 4 (Settings) and the members-ui.css bridge cleanup

detail: Four Settings forms (Resonance matching, Live location, Matching prefs, Consent scopes) each drew their own role="switch" button with bg-primary when on. Under Frequency that resolved to the retired violet, so members-ui.css carried a bridge rule to repaint every hand-built switch. These four now render the shared Switch, which draws the kit's .sw under Frequency and DAWN's track under DAWN, so the bridge has fewer call sites to cover. The notifications grid keeps its own switch for now, because lib/notifications/wired.test.ts pins its source shape. The notifications grid and the Spaces-you-follow switch keep their hand-built buttons (lib/notifications/wired.test.ts reads that source) and wear the kit's .sw class under Frequency.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=['components/settings/resonance-matching-toggle.tsx','components/settings/live-location-toggle.tsx','components/settings/match-prefs-form.tsx','components/settings/consent-scopes-form.tsx'].filter(p=>{const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');return s.includes('role=\"switch\"')||!s.includes('<Switch ')});if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1101: hand-built switch in '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a Settings form goes back to a hand-built switch. Behavior is settings-switches.test.ts.
